title: Riotous Living and Wine
summary: The man sets his heart upon riches and spends his time in riotous living with his wives and concubines; his priests spend their time with harlots. The account then reports his planting vineyards, building wine-presses, and making abundant wine. He and his people become wine-bibbers.

explicit_facts.text: The man places his heart upon his riches and spends time in riotous living with his wives and concubines.
His priests spend their time with harlots.
He plants vineyards round about in the land, builds wine-presses, and makes wine in abundance.
He and his people become wine-bibbers.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Non-dramatic vineyard and wine-press imagery could accompany the report of wine production without showing an invented occasion.
unspecified_visual_details: The man's name and the land's name are not supplied.
Appearances, clothing, group sizes, vineyard layouts, and wine-press designs are unspecified.
Specific activities constituting riotous living and the timing between reported activities are unspecified.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Use one narration-led account, not a shared dramatic occasion. Keep the report of riotous living distinct from the subsequent report of vineyards and wine, preserving textual order without inventing precise chronology.
These verses summarize activities over time; do not reenact them as newly specified present-tense events.
Placing his heart upon riches is figurative, not a visible physical action.
The character list identifies participants in the reports, not a gathering of everyone together.
prohibited_inventions: Do not identify the man as Noah or assign a name or ownership to the land from outside these verses.
Do not combine riotous living, priestly activities, vineyard planting, wine-press construction, and drinking into one simultaneous event.
Do not invent dialogue, specific sexual acts, celebrations, or additional motives.
Do not supply dates, durations, or encounters between the listed groups.
